build_checkerboard_entity: build a CheckerBoard entity with configurable rows and columns for MuJoCo physics simulation
build_goboard_entity: build a GoBoard entity with a 7x7 grid and touch sensors for each intersection
get_contact_indices: get the row and column indices of the most strongly activated touch sensor on the board
validate_finger_touch: validate whether a hand's finger geoms are in contact with a specific board square
sample_pos_inside_touch_sensor: sample a random position inside a touch sensor site with configurable jitter
